eyebrow.zh: v0.2.0：--online 终于听 --harnesses/--task · 单 harness 跑完不再误判证伪
eyebrow.en: v0.2.0: --online now heeds --harnesses/--task · single-harness run no longer falsely falsifies the thesis

headline.zh:
你只想验一个 harness 的真实用量
--online 却把整张 5×3 网格都计了费
headline.en:
You wanted one harness's real usage
--online billed the whole 5×3 grid instead

sub.zh: v0.2.0 之前，--online 路径无视 --harnesses 和 --task——你点名一个 harness（5 次付费调用），它却把 5 任务 × 3 envelope 整张网格（15 次）都打到付费 DeepSeek API 上；--task 打错也无人校验，默默计了全网格的费。现在 --online 把过滤条件原样穿透进去，只为你选的 (harness, task) 对计费，--task 在任何付费调用之前就被解析校验——打错当场 BadParameter、一分不花。另一处：跨 envelope 的 kill floor 本就需要 ≥2 个 harness 才能评，旧逻辑却不查——单 harness（只跑 baseline）的运行会算出「0 个任务 >1.5x」并打印「核心论点证伪，halt」、退出 1，把完全合法的单 harness 试跑误判成证伪。现在 kill floor 受 floor_evaluable 门控：不足 2 个 harness 时跳过（held，不触发），并打一条清楚的「跨方差评估 harness 不足（跑了 N，需 ≥2）；跳过 kill gate」提示，退出干净。
sub.en: Before v0.2.0 the --online path ignored --harnesses and --task — you named one harness (5 paid calls) and it billed the whole 5-task × 3-envelope grid (15 calls) through the paid DeepSeek API; a typoed --task matched nothing and was never validated, so it silently billed the full grid. Now --online threads the filter through and bills only the (harness, task) pairs you selected; --task is resolved and validated (default swe-bench-mini → full set, a specific id → that one task) before any paid API call — a typo surfaces as BadParameter at $0. Separately, the cross-envelope kill floor needs ≥2 harnesses to evaluate by construction, yet the old logic didn't check — a single-harness (baseline-only) run trivially scored '0 tasks above 1.5x' and printed 'core thesis falsified, halt' and exited 1, misreading a perfectly valid single-harness onboarding run as a falsification. Now the floor is gated by floor_evaluable: with fewer than 2 harnesses it is skipped (held, not tripped), and a clear 'insufficient harnesses for cross-variance evaluation (ran N; need ≥2); skipping kill gate' note prints and the run exits clean.

body.zh: 你开 --online --harnesses ClaudeCode，本是想只把这一个 harness 的真实 DeepSeek 用量补齐——可旧版 --online 无视过滤条件，把 5 任务 × 3 envelope 整张网格全打到付费 API 上，你为 5 次调用付了 15 次的钱；--task 打错也匹配不到任何东西、却从不报错，默默把整张网格计了费。现在 --online 把 --harnesses 和 --task 原样穿透进 run_online，只为你选中的 (harness, task) 对走付费 API——默认 swe-bench-mini 仍是全集，swe-bench-mini-001 只跑那一道；--task 在任何付费调用前就被解析校验，打错当场 BadParameter，一分不花。
body.en: You turn on --online --harnesses ClaudeCode to fill in that one harness's real DeepSeek usage — but the old --online ignored the filter and fired the whole 5-task × 3-envelope grid at the paid API, billing 15 calls for the 5 you asked for; a typoed --task matched nothing and never errored, silently billing the entire grid. Now --online threads --harnesses and --task straight into run_online and bills only the (harness, task) pairs you selected through the paid API — the default swe-bench-mini still resolves to the full set, swe-bench-mini-001 runs just that one task; --task is resolved and validated before any paid call, so a typo surfaces as BadParameter at $0.

title.zh: 单 harness 跑完，不再误判证伪
title.en: A single-harness run no longer falsifies the thesis

body.zh: kill floor（mvp_plan §8 #1）评的是跨 envelope 方差——它构造上就需要 ≥2 个 harness 才有意义。可旧逻辑不查 harness 数：只跑 baseline 一个 harness 时，自然算出「0 个任务 >1.5x」，于是打印「核心论点证伪，halt」并退出 1——把完全合法的单 harness 试跑（你边接 harness 边分批测）误判成证伪，直接挡住正常用法。现在 kill floor 受 floor_evaluable 门控：不足 2 个 harness 时跳过（held，不触发），并打一条「跨方差评估 harness 不足（跑了 N，需 ≥2）；跳过 kill gate」的清楚提示，退出干净。论文不再被单 harness 运行假性证伪。
body.en: The kill floor (mvp_plan §8 #1) evaluates CROSS-envelope variance — by construction it needs ≥2 harnesses to mean anything. The old logic never checked the count: a baseline-only single-harness run trivially scored '0 tasks above 1.5x', so it printed 'core thesis falsified, halt' and exited 1 — misreading a perfectly valid single-harness onboarding run (you onboard harnesses one at a time) as a falsification, blocking normal usage. Now the floor is gated by floor_evaluable: with fewer than 2 harnesses it is skipped (held, not tripped), and a clear 'insufficient harnesses for cross-variance evaluation (ran N; need ≥2); skipping kill gate' note prints and the run exits clean. The thesis is no longer falsely falsified by a single-harness run.

title.zh: 投影到你真实的 GPU 座位
title.en: Project it onto your real GPU seats

body.zh: 给定你的 GPU 数和并发座位数，按你测出来的跨 harness 差距，告诉你哪个 harness 撑得住、哪个撑不住、每座多少钱、整柜 capex 多少。换一台机器、换个座位数，重算只需一条命令——envelcost project --gpus 8xH100 --seats 50。
body.en: Give it your GPU count and concurrent seat target, and from the cross-harness gap you measured it tells you which harness fits, which doesn't, the cost per seat, and the rack's total capex. Swap a GPU or a seat count, re-run one command — envelcost project --gpus 8xH100 --seats 50.

chips: › 每座成本 · 整柜 capex

title.zh: 离线 · 可复现 · 数据不出境

body.zh: 核心测算不联网、不要 API key——按实际请求文本离线 tokenize 算出每个 harness 多烧的 token，谁都能复跑出同一张表。可选的 --online 模式（v0.2.0 起过滤条件被正确尊重）用真实 DeepSeek 用量把输出 token 填齐，只为你点名的 (harness, task) 对付费。开源 MIT，自托管免费。
body.en: The core run needs no network and no API key — it tokenizes the actual request text offline to work out the extra tokens each harness burns, so anyone can reproduce the same table. The optional --online mode (filter correctly respected as of v0.2.0) fills in real DeepSeek output-token usage, billing only the (harness, task) pairs you named. Open source under MIT, free to self-host.

chips: › 无联网 · 无 API key
› 离线算 · 谁都能复跑

headline.zh: 把 --online 的计费，钉在你点名的那几个 harness 上
headline.en: Pin --online's billing to the harnesses you actually named

sub.zh: 开源、MIT、自托管免费。容量测算这一核心动作，永不设墙。
sub.en: Open source, MIT, free to self-host. The core act of sizing your capacity is never gated.

tag.zh: 把跨 harness 的 token 成本差距，算成信创 GPU 集群的容量数字
tag.en: Turning cross-harness token-cost gaps into capacity numbers for on-prem GPU clusters

zh: --online 现在尊重 --harnesses 和 --task——过滤条件穿透进 run_online，只为你选中的 (harness, task) 对走付费 DeepSeek API，不再把整张 5 任务 × 3 envelope 网格计费；--task 在任何付费调用前就被解析校验（默认 swe-bench-mini 仍是全集，具体 id 只跑那一道），打错当场 BadParameter、一分不花。
跨 envelope 的 kill floor 不再被单 harness 运行假性证伪——新增 floor_evaluable 门控：不足 2 个 harness 时跳过 kill gate（held，不触发），并打一条「跨方差评估 harness 不足（跑了 N，需 ≥2）；跳过 kill gate」的清楚提示、退出干净，而非打印「核心论点证伪，halt」并退出 1。
en: --online now respects --harnesses and --task — the filter threads into run_online, billing only the (harness, task) pairs you selected through the paid DeepSeek API instead of the full 5-task × 3-envelope grid; --task is resolved and validated before any paid call (the default swe-bench-mini still resolves to the full set, a specific id runs just that one task), so a typo surfaces as BadParameter at $0.

The cross-envelope kill floor is no longer falsely falsified by a single-harness run — a new floor_evaluable gate skips the kill floor (held, not tripped) when fewer than 2 harnesses ran, printing a clear 'insufficient harnesses for cross-variance evaluation (ran N; need ≥2); skipping kill gate' note and exiting clean, instead of printing 'core thesis falsified, halt' and exiting 1.
